items.title: Boy, 6, in coma after pool accident in Egypt being flown back to Italy - Tajani
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, SEP 3 - A six-year-old boy who has been in a coma in an Egyptian hospital since an August 3 accident at a swimming pool at Sharm El Sheikh is currently being flown back to Italy, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on a visit to Cairo Thursday. The boy, Younes Majidi, who suffered a cardiac arrest and has been in critical condition since nearly drowning at the Red Sea resort, will be admitted for treatment at the Regina Margherita Children's Hospital in Turin, said Tajani, who is also deputy premier. (ANSA). Read article...

items.title: Boy, 6, in coma after pool accident in Egypt being flown back to Italy - Tajani
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, SEP 3 - A six-year-old boy who has been in a coma in an Egyptian hospital since an August 3 accident at a swimming pool at Sharm El Sheikh is currently being flown back to Italy, Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on a visit to Cairo Thursday. The boy, Younes Majidi, who suffered a cardiac arrest and has been in critical condition since nearly drowning at the Red Sea resort, will be admitted for treatment at the Regina Margherita Children's Hospital in Turin, said Tajani, who is also deputy premier. (ANSA). Read article...
